summary: Grove Collaborative Holdings filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting quarterly earnings per Item 2.02, posting an investor presentation under Regulation FD (Item 7.01), and providing general disclosure channels as an Other Event (Item 8.01). The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change. It is purely a routine earnings and investor-relations disclosure. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation.
